newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sept yr-on-yr industrial index up 9.5pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sept yr-on-yr industrial index up 9.5pct.

text.p: Malaysia's industrial production index rose 9.5 percent in September 1996 compared to September a year ago, the national Bernama news agency reported.
On a month-on-month basis, the index was up 0.7 percent from August 1996, the agency quoted the Statistics Department as saying late on Friday.
The Statistics Department said the index gained 10.6 percent to 229.5 from 207.5 for the first nine months of 1996 compared with the same period a year ago.
The index is a measure of the rate change in the production of industrial commodities over time.
In the nine-month period, the mining division index rose 5.1 percent to 144.6, manufacturing rose 11.9 percent to 272 and electricity rose 12.9 to 265.9.
